About Me

Professional background

I serve in the United States Navy as a Sonar Technician and have gained hands-on experience in technical operations, maintenance, team leadership, training coordination, safety, and personnel development. I am also pursuing a cybersecurity degree at Old Dominion University, with academic interests in real estate and risk management. My goal is to bring a disciplined, adaptable, and analytical approach to future professional opportunities.
